column1: # Original DICE Crossfire, play time 680 kOhm (minimum; a game lasts about 74.7 s).
# Coin starts; recorded closed-loop play by the left gun, the right gun, both, and
# each alone again (2000-70000 ms); a coin at 65000 ms (after the GNE warning)
# changes nothing; the timer ends the game; right Fire at 77000 ms does not start
# one; a coin at 79000 ms restarts and the left gun scores. Rows: ms action value.
